seo.description: Listening comprehension practice test for beginners and elementary students (CEFR A1 level). The past. Life changes. English listening test.

parts:
A1 English Listening Test

Listen to four people talking about last summer. For questions 1 to 7, choose the correct answer.

See the full list of A1 listening tests
Questions

choices.html: She went to Greece with her friends.
She spent time at a hospital in Greece.

questions.prompt: When was the weather bad for John?

choices.html: on both his family holiday and his walking holiday

questions.prompt: Which is true about Claire's family holiday?

choices.html: Her family will go to the same place next year.
Her family always stayed together during the holiday.
Her family spent some time watching animals.

questions.prompt: Who in Claire’s family likes to go to bars in the evening?

choices.html: The first week was better than the second.
The second week was better than the first.
